entries.49f600d9f23fc552: A restaurant chain that operates the British-style pubs "HUB" and "82" at 110 locations nationwide, serving drinks centered on beer and British-style food.
entries.674cdfd02e79cd72: This is the company's only segment, operating British-style pubs. The company operates 110 stores across six regions (Hokkaido, Tohoku, Kanto, Chubu, Kinki and Kyushu) as of February 28, 2026, mainly opening in downtown and office districts in front of train stations and in commercial facilities. There are two brands: the "HUB" brand, targeting relatively younger customers in their 20s and 30s, and the "82 (Eighty-Two)" brand, targeting mature customers in their 30s to 50s. The stores offer mainly beer, along with cocktails, wine and whisky, and food including fish and chips, a representative British dish. The company has introduced a "cash on delivery system" in which payment is made in advance, and service is basically self-service.
